   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  MARCH 10, 2025

Chair Leon called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m. Responding to roll call were Vice Chair Ang and
Commissioner Sanchez. Also present was Rosalee Santa Ana, Senior Management Analyst, Alex
Ocegueda, Office Assistant III and Jocelyn Hernandez, Communications Specialist.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Vice Chair Ang made the motion and Commissioner Sanchez seconded to approve the minutes for
February 10, 2024. There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

Reorganization of Chair & Vice Chair

Commissioner Sanchez motioned to have both Chair Leon and Vice Chair Ang continue in their
respective roles for another year. All Commissioners agreed. There being no objection, the motion
carried.

Artastic

Mrs. Ocegueda informed Commissioners that they will have a table at the Artastic event and recreation
staff suggested having candy as one of the giveaways at their table. Mrs. Ocegueda presented the
Commissioners with the merchandise survey questions for their review. All Commissioners approved
the survey and the purchase of candy. Commissioner Ang and Commissioner Leon will be present;
Commissioner Sanchez will try to attend.

Meet & Greet Dinner

Mrs. Ocegueda informed Commissioners that she has already reached out to the Recreation
Department to borrow any of their Hawaiian themed décor. Mrs. Ocegueda stated she will have catering
pricing for Waba Grill, Don’s Terriyaki and L&L Bbq at the next meeting. Commissioners stated they
want Mrs. Ocegueda to get pricing for the following items as party favors: notepads, pens, string
backpacks and padfolios. They would like the city logo with 2025 Commissioners Appreciation wording
as the party favor personalization. Commissioners also decided to ask the invited Commissions to each
bring in their favorite desserts on the event flyer.

Business Spotlight

Ms. Santa Ana showed the “Keeping It Norwalk” Campaign, the February Best Breakfast Spots edition
video to Commissioners. Vice Chair Ang agreed with one of the comments left by a resident that Mr.
Rosewoods should be in First Place. Mrs. Ocegueda stated that she followed the Commission’s
regulations and although Mr. Rosewoods did win First Place, they, along with the Second-Place winner
were dropped from the list because they did not have a valid current city business license.
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting
Community Promotion Commission
March 10, 2025

Communications and Public Affairs Analytics

Ms. Santa Ana provided the analytics and explained Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and the city’s
overall reach across all outreach platforms for the last month showing an increase in key metrics.
Commissioner Leon suggested that the negative sentiment may have been due to the lawsuit Governor
Newsom has against the city.

STAFF COMMENTS:

Mrs. Ocegueda provided Commissioners with copies of the Planning and Engineering Departments
Landscaping Guidelines and explained the current process a resident must comply with to get approval
to make changes to their landscape and city parkway.

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Commissioner Sanchez is excited to participate in Norwalk’s 2nd Annual 5K Run and is also going to
participate in the Santa Fe Springs 5K. Vice Chair Ang attended Councilmember Ana Valencia’s
appointees’ dinner and was updated by City Manager Jesus Gomez on projects that will be moving
forward, including the Youth Authority project. Chair Leon praised the response time of the Public
Services Department’s Graffiti clean-up crew when she reported gang graffiti.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

No Oral Communication

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:47 p.m.

_____________________________

Armida Leon, Chair
Community Promotion Commission
